description: Flood Risk Communication Toolbox is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USACE, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers. This toolbox provides resources for communicating with sponsors, stakeholders, and the public about flood risk and flood risk management projects. It features information about the principles and best practices of risk communication, as well as materials that can be distributed directly to the public. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Water Quality. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Critical Facilities, Economy, Energy and Utilities, People, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Urban Landscape and Tree Canopy, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
